title: A tool call of any kind leaves one closed ops row of its tool, command class, agent group, duration and size
goal: ql_capture writes an ops row call.tool for every PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure event, whatever the tool: tool group, a closed class of the Bash or PowerShell command head (never command text or a path), agent group, outcome, duration_ms when the event has one and the result size class, so kb/_querylog/ops/ holds a census of tool calls that outlives the transcripts' retention; kbusage.py tree reads the same classes, so the two agree on the same session.

gates.question: Approve recording a closed row per tool call (tool group, command-head class, agent group, outcome, duration, size class) for every tool, not only the kb's?
options: approve, kb tools and shell only
gates.answer: approve, kb tools and shell only
